en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a town square lined with multi‑storey historic buildings. The image shows the Neumarkt (New Market) in Oschatz, with shops, inns and signage on the façades, a central monument or fountain, horse‑drawn cart, street lamps, and a few people in early 20th‑century clothing. The lower margin contains printed red text describing the scene and the publisher's information.
